enemies.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite animation sheet with actual transparent alpha background. Create ONE complete 6-column by 5-row animation sheet, exactly 30 distinct full-body poses, equal grid cells, no labels or lines. Subject: original Frostmaw Yeti, massive broad-shouldered shaggy alpine ape brute, ivory and grey fur, dark slate exposed face and hands, short icy beard, large clawed hands, hunched two-legged stance. NO wings, dragon, horns, weapons, clothing. Painted realistic dark-fantasy isometric ARPG sprite, detailed restrained palette, lit upper left, three-quarter facing down-right, entire body visible every cell, ample transparent margins, consistent body size, feet baseline and character identity. Row1: six subtle idle/walking poses. Row2: claw swipe attack, frames 1-3 windup drawing right arm back, frame4 full sweeping claw strike, frames5-6 follow-through and recover. Row3: cold breath attack, frames1-3 crouch and inhale with chest swelling, frame4 mouth opens exhaling a short pale ice mist, frames5-6 expel mist and recover. Keep mist short within its own cell. Row4: ground slam frames1-3 raise BOTH fists overhead, frame4 pound ground, frame5 recoil low, frame6 stand up. Row5: death: stagger, knees buckle, tip sideways, impact ground, settle, entirely prone heavy furred corpse. Death poses retain same anatomical size as living body, no smaller character. Output wide landscape image with six columns and five rows exactly. All cells isolated with real transparency, no floor shadows, no checkerboard, no background, no text.

Create ONE image, exactly 6 columns and 7 rows, six sequential poses per row, all isolated cutouts on actual alpha transparency. Detailed realistic hand-painted game sprites, restrained dark palette, directional upper-left light, high-angle three-quarter view facing screen-right. Characters:
imp: small lean red-skinned horned demon with small leather bat wings, long pointed tail, clawed feet, worn brown loincloth, short dark iron dagger; casting orange fire with free hand
spider: large black eight-legged spider, thick segmented black chitin, broad black abdomen with an ivory skull marking, long pointed jointed legs and hooked mandibles

ROW 5: Character imp: slam. brace, lift arms/weapon, fully overhead, smash down into ground, recoil low, recover.

Each attack has three clearly distinct windup poses, frame4 impact/release, frame5 follow-through, frame6 recovery. Every cell ALWAYS contains the full character, even while casting or throwing a projectile. Never replace a character with a projectile. Use tiny attached accents only. Six distinct body/limb poses per row. Death is progressive collapse into low prone remains, not six standing variations. Keep anatomical scale consistent through the entire character's sequences, do not enlarge corpses. Very generous transparent gutters, every complete body and weapon must fit within its cell. No floor, shadows, text, labels, grid, background color or checkerboard. Deliver genuine transparent PNG alpha.
